source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; Schedule of Adjustments line 34 (PDF p.24; bundle PDF p.4); Department FAQ 3; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 34,050.00 + military pension person 0 40,000.00 = 74,050.00. Federal taxable income = 74,050.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 58,300.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 74,050.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: line 34 uniformed services retirement 40,000.00; line 47 total 40,000.00; line 2b 40,000.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 74,050.00 + 0.00 - 40,000.00 = 34,050.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 34,050.00, in the band 40,000 or less: 2,400.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,400.00 = 2,400.00. Line 5 = 34,050.00 - 2,400.00 = 31,650.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 31,650.00. Line 8a tax: 31,650.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (31,650.00 - 26,050.00 = 5,600.00) = 342.00 + 154.00 = 496.00. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 496.00. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 34,050.00 - 2,400.00 = 31,650.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 496.00 - 0.00 = 496.00. State income tax 496.00. Military retirement is deducted in full, so it counts for no credit (PDF p.28), and MAGI after it is 34,050.00, so 2,400.
